assertions.assertion: The member has a history of paroxysmal palpitations and episodic lightheadedness, raising concern for recurrent supraventricular tachycardia and underlying atrial fibrillation.
There has been a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack.
Continuous ambulatory monitoring is clinically indicated to assess for arrhythmic burden and guide anticoagulation therapy.
The CPT 93226 48-hour Holter monitoring study is medically necessary.
